summary: Join our Digital Banking and Regulatory Challenges Training Course to navigate complex regulations and boost your skills in the digital finance sector.
lede: Digital banking regulation training helps financial services professionals turn regulatory obligations into product policies and controls. It is for digital banking and fintech product managers, compliance and risk teams, payments staff, auditors, and others responsible for financial services. Participants practise mapping obligations, reviewing customer onboarding and transaction monitoring, managing data and partner risks, strengthening consumer protection, and preparing evidence for audits and regulatory examinations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly balance digital innovation with compliance, risk, and governance.
audience: Risk managers (operational, fraud, credit, enterprise risk)
IT, cybersecurity, and data governance leads
modules: The Digital Banking Reality and the Regulatory Pressure
Regulatory Landscape for Digital Financial Services
Digital Customer Onboarding, eKYC, and Identity Assurance
AML/CFT in Digital Channels and Transaction Monitoring
Digital Lending, Responsible Finance, and Consumer Protection
Data Privacy, Data Governance, and Regulatory Expectations
Cybersecurity, Fraud Risk, and Digital Banking Controls
Operational Resilience and Business Continuity in Digital Banking
Third-Party, Outsourcing, Agency Banking, and Partnership Risk
Governance, Policies, and Compliance by Design
Regulatory Reporting, Audits, and Examination Readiness
Ethical, Inclusive, and Sustainable Digital Banking
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of digital banking operations and basic regulatory frameworks. Experience in compliance, risk management, or digital product development is beneficial.
